description: Source code for a Zephyr driver implementing voltage comparator functionality for the ITE IT8XXX2 series, including configuration, interrupt handling, and sensor API integration.

methods.name: clear_vcmp_status
methods.description: Clears the interrupt status for a specific voltage comparator channel.

methods.name: vcmp_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific voltage comparator channel.

methods.name: vcmp_set_threshold
methods.description: Sets the threshold value for voltage comparator interrupt triggering.

methods.name: it8xxx2_vcmp_trigger_work_handler
methods.description: Handles work triggered by voltage comparator interrupt, calling user handler.

methods.name: vcmp_ite_it8xxx2_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as thresholds and alert state.

methods.name: vcmp_ite_it8xxx2_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures trigger conditions and associated handler for voltage comparator.

methods.name: vcmp_it8xxx2_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling voltage comparator interrupts.

methods.name: vcmp_it8xxx2_init
methods.description: Initializes the voltage comparator device, configures hardware, and sets up interrupts.
